headline: A 2014 law makes technical cleanup changes to title 36 of the U.S. Code, which covers patriotic observances, ceremonies, and national organizations.
what_it_does: The law updates the tables of contents for title 36 and its subtitles so they match the current text. It also changes how chapter headings are formatted and fixes small errors in subtitle and chapter headings. The summary describes these as technical corrections and does not describe any new rights, costs, or program changes.
when_it_takes_effect: The law was enacted on December 18, 2014. The summary does not list a separate effective date.
